title: Capacity to Ship Packages Within D Days
summary: Ship the packages in their listed order over at most days days.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ days ≤ length(weights) ≤ 50000. Each weight is in [1,500]. Packages cannot be split or reordered.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Ship the packages in their listed order over at most days days. Each day carries a consecutive prefix of the remaining packages with total weight at most the ship capacity. Return the smallest integer capacity that allows all packages to leave.

examples.explanation: Split after the second package. Capacity 5 needs three days.
Each package may travel on its own day.

constraints: 1 ≤ days ≤ length(weights) ≤ 50000. Each weight is in [1,500]. Packages cannot be split or reordered.
hints: Conceptual: A capacity that works keeps working when increased.
Directional: Search capacities between the largest package and the total weight.
Implementation: For a candidate capacity, greedily fill each day in order and count how many days are needed.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log S) time and O(1) auxiliary space, where S is the total weight.
